verses.1: And I saw another angel coming down from heaven, powerful and mighty. His face was covered with clouds, and his head resembled the sun. His feet were like flames of fire.
verses.2: And he had a small book in his hand. He placed his right foot on the sea, and his left foot on the land.
verses.3: And he cried out with a loud voice, like a bee. And when he cried out, the seven trumpets also sounded their respective voices.
verses.4: And when the seven voices spoke, we were about to write down what they said. Then I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Do not write down what the seven voices said.”
verses.5: And the angel, whom we saw several times both on the sea and on land, raised his right hand towards heaven.
verses.6: And He will also be with those who live through the ages. He created heaven and everything in it, as well as the earth and everything on it, and the sea and everything in it. For time will no longer exist anymore.
verses.7: But on the days of the seventh angel’s message, when it is time to sound the trumpet, and the mystery of God is fulfilled, as He revealed to His own servants, the prophets.
verses.8: And the voice that I heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, “Take the book that is sealed in the hand of the angel of the covenant, and throw it into the sea and onto the earth.”
verses.9: And I went to the messenger and said to him, “Give me that book.” He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach feel good. But inside your mouth, it will taste sweet like honey.”
verses.10: And we took the book from the messenger’s hand, and ate it. It tasted like sweet honey in my mouth. When I ate it, my stomach felt full.
verses.11: And they say to me: You must once again prophesy to peoples, nations, languages, and many kings.
